question.hi: Internet aur WWW mein fark spasht karo, example ke saath.
question.en: Clarify the difference between the Internet and WWW, with an example.

answer.hi:
Internet: duniya bhar ke computers ka underlying physical/global network — hardware infrastructure jo data transfer possible banaata hai.
WWW: is network par chalne wala ek service/system, jisme interlinked documents/webpages hote hain, jinhe hyperlinks se navigate karte hain.
Example: Internet wo 'roads' hain, WWW un roads par chalne wali ek specific 'service' (jaise webpages dekhna) hai — jaise email bhi internet ki hi ek service hai, WWW nahi.
answer.en:
Internet: the underlying physical/global network of computers worldwide — the hardware infrastructure that makes data transfer possible.
WWW: a service/system running on this network, consisting of interlinked documents/webpages navigable via hyperlinks.
Example: the Internet is like the 'roads', WWW is one specific 'service' (viewing webpages) running on those roads — email is another internet service that isn't part of WWW.

question.hi: SMTP aur POP3 mein fark batao, aur ye kab use hote hain.
question.en: Differentiate between SMTP and POP3, and state when each is used.

answer.hi:
SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol): email SEND karne ke liye use hota hai — jab tum 'send' button dabate ho.
POP3 (Post Office Protocol v3): email RECEIVE karne/download karne ke liye use hota hai — jab tumhara inbox naye emails fetch karta hai.
answer.en:
SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol): used to SEND email — used when you press the 'send' button.
POP3 (Post Office Protocol v3): used to RECEIVE/download email — used when your inbox fetches new emails.

question.hi: Downloading aur Uploading mein fark batao, ek example diagram/scenario ke saath.
question.en: Differentiate between Downloading and Uploading, with an example scenario.

answer.hi:
Downloading: file ko remote server SE apne computer PAR laana (jaise koi PDF apne phone mein save karna).
Uploading: file ko apne computer SE kisi remote server PAR bhejna (jaise Instagram par photo post karna).
answer.en:
Downloading: transferring a file FROM a remote server TO your computer (like saving a PDF to your phone).
Uploading: sending a file FROM your computer TO a remote server (like posting a photo on Instagram).

question.hi: Mobile technologies (SMS, MMS, 3G, 4G, 5G) ko unki key features ke saath describe karo.
question.en: Describe mobile technologies (SMS, MMS, 3G, 4G, 5G) with their key features.

answer.hi:
SMS: sirf text messages (160 chars tak).
MMS: text ke saath images/audio/video bhi bhej sakta hai.
3G: mobile internet ko practical banaya — video calls, mobile web possible hua.
4G (LTE): high-speed streaming aur gaming enable kiya.
5G: sabse high speed, sabse kam latency, IoT devices ko support karta hai.
answer.en:
SMS: text messages only (up to 160 chars).
MMS: can send images/audio/video along with text.
3G: made mobile internet practical — enabled video calls, mobile web.
4G (LTE): enabled high-speed streaming and gaming.
5G: highest speed, lowest latency, supports IoT devices.
